_comment: What Oracle's intro card says in each space. Edit freely — this file is data, not code, and is re-read on each deploy. Keys under `spaces` are space display names, matched case-insensitively; a space with no entry gets `generic`. EVERY `can` line names its command or trigger AND says how it is used in THAT space, then what Oracle does: "/track on an announcement asking everyone to do something — I post a checklist and summarise it for you at the deadline." At most four are shown (MAX_LINES in src/cards/intro-card.js). `examples` are copy-paste prompts, shown behind the card's own button and in a /help reply. `privately` and `goodToKnow` are the same everywhere except that a space Oracle keeps a copy of (data/chat/listen-spaces.json) also gets `listeningNote`. Loader: src/cards/intro-card.js
privately: DM me for anything you'd rather not ask in front of the team — a client's history, a draft, or "what did we decide about X?"
DM me "digest" for what's waiting on you, or "what can you do?" for the full list.
goodToKnow: In a space I only see messages where I'm @mentioned.
Before I change anything in HubSpot, a calendar or a Doc, I show you exactly what I'd do — anyone in the thread can reply "yes" to confirm.
I never contact a client. Drafts come back to you.
listeningNote: I keep a 12-month copy of this space's messages so I can answer questions about past discussions here. I still only reply when you @mention me.

can: /track as a reply to an ask — one card shows who has the ball, until it's decided or done.
/meet with the people @mentioned — the three earliest times you're all free, and one press books it with a Meet link.
/watch as a reply to a post about a funding program — I DM you before it opens, 14 and 2 days before its deadline, and if it closes.
@Oracle <a question about a client, a grant, a Drive file or a past discussion> — I answer from HubSpot, Drive and our own grant data.
examples: @Oracle what's the status of the Acme deal?
@Oracle summarise this thread into next steps

can: @Oracle <a lead's name and their email or phone> — I triage it: what HubSpot knows, which tier they look like, and who should call.
digest — what's waiting on you, across every card.
/track and /meet work here too — with no thread to reply to, I use the message just above, and ask if it could be more than one.
@Oracle <any question about clients, grants, calendars or Drive> — the same answers as in a space, privately.
examples: What do we know about Acme Foods?
Sarah called in — 604-555-1212, wants to know about training grants
Which of our clients fit CanExport?
Draft a follow-up to the Acme review
